full_prompt_en: A square straight-down aerial photograph looks over a dense city district at dusk, turning streets, roofs, and small planted courts into a tightly fitted geometric pattern. There is no visible horizon and no tilted façade; every surface is seen from directly above, so distance is organized by the planar street grid rather than conventional foreground and background. Dark gray blocks of closely packed buildings occupy both sides. Their flat roofs vary in size and height, with scattered pale blue-gray rectangles, narrow terraces, and small inner courtyards breaking the darker mass. A wider north-south avenue runs through the middle, intersected by warm amber east-west roads at the upper third and lower middle. Tiny points of orange light mark the intersections and trace fine luminous seams between the blocks. Near the center, a formal square interrupts the density: tan paths outline nested rectangles around a compact central building or monument, while grass and tree patches make deep green shapes inside the grid. Farther down, a slim green axis continues between buildings, adding a calmer vertical rhythm to the roof texture. The edges remain crowded and irregular, and the central square gives the eye a clear, measured pause. Teal and cool slate tones settle across the roofs, mixed with very dark green foliage and the warm copper lines of lit streets. Fine architectural detail is visible but compressed by the height of the viewpoint, reading as intricate surface texture rather than individual scenes. Dusk light is even and subdued, with no dominant directional shadow; the street lamps provide the strongest highlights. The image feels both documentary and patterned, using an absolute overhead angle and bright road lines to reveal an ordered center within a complex urban fabric.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形垂直俯拍的航拍照片在暮色中望向密集城区，让道路、屋顶和小块植被庭院拼成紧密的几何图案。画面没有地平线，也没有倾斜的立面；所有表面都从正上方看见，纵深由平面的街道网格而非传统前后景组织。深灰色的密集建筑群占据两侧。平屋顶的大小和高度各异，散落的浅蓝灰矩形、狭窄露台与小内院打破深色体块。一条较宽的南北大道穿过中央，在上方三分之一处和中下部与暖琥珀色东西向道路相交。微小橙色灯点标记路口，并在街区之间勾出细亮接缝。靠近中心，一片规整广场打断密度：棕褐色路径围出层层矩形，环绕紧凑的中央建筑或纪念物，草地与树丛在网格内形成深绿形状。再往下，一道纤细绿色轴线在建筑之间延续，给屋顶纹理增加平静的竖向节奏。边缘仍然拥挤且不规则，中央广场则让视线获得清晰、节制的停顿。青绿与冷石板色铺在屋顶上，混合很深的叶绿色以及亮起街道的暖铜色线条。细小建筑细节虽可见，却被高空视角压缩，成为复杂的表面纹理，而非各自独立的场景。暮光均匀而克制，没有占主导的定向阴影；路灯提供最强亮点。这幅图兼具纪实和图案感，以绝对俯视角度与明亮道路线条，在复杂城市肌理中揭示一个有秩序的中心。
style_prompt_en: A straight-down aerial photographic treatment compresses depth into a precise planar mosaic. The frame is filled edge to edge with many small rectangular units, varied in size and tone but held together by an orthogonal network of narrow lines. Cool slate gray and muted teal cover most of the surface; deep green clusters interrupt the mineral color, while thin copper-amber seams and small glowing junctions provide a measured warm counterpoint. One more regular nested rectangular zone near the center establishes a clear visual pause within the busier surrounding texture. The elevated scale makes individual details small and dense, so repeated shapes become pattern without losing their photographic irregularity. Edges are generally sharp in the near-planar surface, although low evening light softens contrast within darker areas. Illumination is broadly even, with the warm lines carrying the brightest values rather than a single spotlight. The overall rhythm moves between crowded granular margins, straight connecting axes, and a calm structured center, creating a detailed yet readable overhead image.
style_prompt_zh: 垂直俯拍的航拍摄影处理把纵深压缩成精确的平面镶嵌图。画面从边到边填满大小和色调各异的小矩形单元，由正交的窄线网络维系。冷石板灰与低饱和青绿覆盖大部分表面，深绿簇群打断矿物般色彩；细铜琥珀色接缝和微亮交点则提供节制的暖色对照。靠近中心的一块更规则的嵌套矩形区域，在周围更繁密的纹理中建立清晰的视觉停顿。高空尺度让单项细节变小变密，重复形状成为图案，同时保留摄影的不规则感。近乎平面的表面边缘总体清晰，低暮光却柔化暗部的内部对比。照明广泛而均匀，暖色线条承载最亮的数值，而非单一聚光点。整体节奏在拥挤的颗粒化边缘、笔直的连接轴线与平静的结构化中心之间移动，形成细节丰富而可读的俯视图像。
theme_en: A straight-down aerial view of dense city blocks and a formal green square at dusk
theme_zh: 暮色中垂直俯拍的密集街区与规整绿地广场
name: Aerial view
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
